text:
elaine: RFC follow-up: proposing an "acceptance-tier" model for onboarding so we can run progressively heavier validation without blocking fast rollouts. thoughts?

elaine: motivation: right now teams either wait for a full bench (hours) or skip checks. we need a middle ground that catches regressions early but doesn't add days.

_toby: love this. what's a tier? quick straw: tier0 (lint+basic smoke), tier1 (golden prompts + perf estimate), tier2 (full microbench + adversarial sampling).

_srin: +1. need clear contracts for each tier so frontend/client can opt-in to required level. also need a way to mark "must-pass" vs "informational" checks.

elaine: sketch of the config the analyzer would emit at ingest:

```json
{
  "model_id": "m-123",
  "params_m": 12,
  "peak_seq": 2048,
  "quant_modes": ["fp16","int8"],
  "recommended_tier": "tier1",
  "estimated_gpu_s": 420
}
```

elaine: how we map to tiers:
- tier0: < 100ms smoke, tokenization sanity, shape/ffi lint
- tier1: golden prompts (per-customer+global), perf sampling (short), basic safety heuristics
- tier2: full microbench, adversarial and tail-latency stress runs

marco: operational notes: tier1 should run in ~5m and be 95% unblocked for small models. tier2 can be queued for off-peak or dedicated bench hosts. we should expose ETA in UI.

ci-bot: automation: added pipeline step "tier-decider". flag `--force-tier` available for platform overrides.

_toby: regression detection: use two signals from tier1: (1) golden delta score (thresholded), (2) embedding drift measured with cheap KNN on sample set. if either crosses, block or require manual review.

_srin: embedding drift is nice but need deterministic sampling. prefer reservoir of canonical examples per org + hash-based selection to avoid training-set leakage.

elaine: agree. plan: per-org golden set (private) + platform golden set (public). golden checks run under tier1 and always before any canary rollout. failing golden = block.

marco: cost accounting: annotate estimates in model metadata and debit org budget when tier2 starts. if org budget exceeded, move tier2 to best-effort window. alerts on spikes.

ops-bot: note: added alert rule 'OnboardTier2BudgetExceeded' -> pager to infra if >3 orgs hit limit concurrently.

_toby: what about partial acceptances? e.g., pass tier1 but tier2 pending. API should allow a flag `admit: partial(tier1)` so devs can deploy with a probation label and higher observability.

elaine: yes: UI/state model: admitted: none | partial:tierN | fully-admitted. partial should wire extra logging, stricter canary thresholds, and auto-block if tier2 later fails.

_srin: preemption/backpressure: tier2 jobs should not steal slots from tier0/1. scheduler needs soft isolation pools. also expose a preflight ETA so teams can choose to skip tier2 and accept risk.

marco: testing: we'll synthesize models with exaggerated params/seq and run the full pipeline. add chaos tests where golden set mutated to ensure blocker behavior.

elaine: rollout plan: (1) implement analyzer output and tier-decider (2w), (2) wire golden-runner into tier1 (1w), (3) scheduler isolation for tier0/1 vs tier2 (2w), (4) canary on 5 orgs for 7d.

ci-bot: created ticket ML-1842: "acceptance-tier pipeline + golden-runner" assigned to @elaine and @toby.

marco: ownership: infra builds scheduler isolation; eng-ml builds analyzer + golden harness; devex surfaces UI state and admission flags. ops will monitor budget alerts.

_srin: nit: ensure model metadata includes provenance + analyzer-version so we can re-run tiers if analyzer improves.

elaine: yep, analyzer-versioned outputs and re-eval hooks planned. decision summary:
- add acceptance tiers 0/1/2 with clear contracts
- analyzer emits cost estimates + recommended tier
- golden prompt checks in tier1 (blocker) with per-org/private sets
- tier2 run on isolated capacity, cost-debited, best-effort if over budget
- partial admission states in API/UI for faster rollouts
- spike + 7d canary on small set of orgs

_toby: +1. I'll prototype the golden delta metric and low-cost embedding checker.

elaine: I'll prototype the analyzer and tier-decider. thanks everyone. :rocket:

ci-bot: scheduled re-review: in 14 days for canary results.
